selection.conditional_rationale: A resettable text environment with a simulator terminal state is a candidate for fresh transfer and retention measurement. This is conditional on the blocking license-scope audit and later G0 measurement qualification.
selection.not_ready_for_execution: No installation, download, environment launch, task execution, efficacy evaluation, or G0/G1 decision is authorized by this record.

minimal_source_files.role: official text-only installation and environment description
official game-data layout and split description
official release-asset downloader and asset locations

official_downloaded_assets.observation: Hashes and byte sizes were observed by streaming the official GitHub release bytes on 2026-08-30. GitHub API release digest fields were null; these observed SHA-256 values do not establish a dataset or annotation license.

blocking_license_scope.unresolved_question: The checked code license does not itself establish permission for downloaded game data, human annotations, ALFRED-derived trajectories, PDDL files, or release assets.
required_before_any_execution: Locate and source-pin an authoritative license or permission notice covering each selected release asset and its annotation/provenance scope.
Record compatibility of that permission with the planned local storage, derived split manifests, and any publication.
Bind locally retained asset bytes to the observed source hashes only after permission scope is resolved.

future_g0_g1_fairness_contract.fresh_transfer: Use a precommitted, unseen validation final holdout that is never supplied to lesson extraction, revision construction, retrieval, prompt authoring, or calibration decisions.
future_g0_g1_fairness_contract.retention: Measure the same frozen fresh distribution after a predeclared interference interval; do not select the interval after outcomes are inspected.
future_g0_g1_fairness_contract.independent_evaluator: Run terminal-success scoring in a separately identified evaluator boundary that reads only permitted simulator outcome state and is independent of actor, B2 lesson construction, and H1 revision admission.
future_g0_g1_fairness_contract.information_fairness: B2 and H1 receive the same sealed training trajectories, independently produced outcomes, base model, tools, action grammar, and matched resource budget. B2 uses only its arm-private lesson/retrieval state; H1 uses only its declared compiled readset.
forbidden_actor_inputs: cross-arm cache, index, lesson, trajectory, or durable state
